events.title: Juneteenth: Emancipation Announced in Texas
events.description: Union Major General Gordon Granger arrived in Galveston, Texas, and issued General Order No. 3, announcing that all enslaved people were free. The announcement came more than two years after the Emancipation Proclamation took effect.
events.significance: The date is commemorated as Juneteenth, the oldest national celebration of the end of slavery in the United States, and became a federal holiday in 2021.

events.title: Execution of Emperor Maximilian I of Mexico
events.description: Maximilian I, the Habsburg archduke installed as Emperor of Mexico with French backing, was executed by firing squad in Querétaro after Republican forces under Benito Juárez defeated his regime.
events.significance: His death ended the Second Mexican Empire and the French intervention in Mexico, restoring the Mexican Republic.

events.title: Birth of Blaise Pascal
events.description: Blaise Pascal, the French mathematician, physicist, and philosopher, was born in Clermont-Ferrand, France. He later made foundational contributions to probability theory, fluid mechanics, and geometry, and wrote the Pensées.
events.significance: Pascal's work shaped modern probability and hydrodynamics, and the unit of pressure, the pascal, is named in his honor.

events.title: Execution of Julius and Ethel Rosenberg
events.description: Julius and Ethel Rosenberg were executed at Sing Sing Prison in New York after being convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for passing atomic secrets to the Soviet Union.
events.significance: The case became a defining episode of Cold War anxieties and remains debated for its use of evidence and the severity of the sentences.

events.title: Garfield Comic Strip Debuts
events.description: Jim Davis's comic strip Garfield, featuring a lasagna-loving, sarcastic orange cat, was first published in 41 newspapers in the United States.
events.significance: Garfield grew into one of the most widely syndicated comic strips in the world, spawning television shows, films, and extensive merchandise.
